amends: nba-multimarket-research-1.3 (same model, same code path; only the injury reports that feed it change); RUN071, v1.2-v1.4b and the live v1.3 cohort untouched
inherits: multimarket_v13_protocol.json and multimarket_v12_protocol.json (windows, ridge, categories, T-60 rule, seeds, bootstrap, reference lines)
hypothesis: v1.3 was trained and evaluated with one report per day (13:30 or 17:30 ET), so a listed status was on average 5.5 h older than at the live cutoff; with the report closest before tipoff minus 60 min the statuses are sharper (Out plays 0.8% instead of 4.3%), the participation table and the missing-value terms carry more signal, and the team and player markets should improve

arms.candidate: the same v1.3 code with reports = the reference reports plus nba_injury_t60_20261021/reports.jsonl.gz; the latest report at least 60 minutes before tipoff wins per game and player (unchanged status_map); training and test both use the candidate reports

no_other_change: no new feature, category, floor or window; G League stays inside the v1.3 statuses
reproduction_check: the reference arm must reproduce the candidate Brier stored in nba_f6_v13_20261021/comparison_v13.json to 1e-9 for every market and test season, or the run aborts

season_roles.2025-26: primary: both training seasons (2023-24, 2024-25) have T-60 reports
season_roles.2024-25: secondary: its training window includes 2022-23, whose reports stay at the old quality (the old parser for that layout is not in the repo), so the candidate is only partly upgraded in training

primary_comparison: candidate vs reference on identical rows, paired Brier difference with 95% date bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 20261021), per market and test season
secondary: participation log loss of each arm's status table on the listed rows present in both arms with a box score
number of listed rows and observed games per arm
fitted weights of the missing-value terms per arm
decision_rule: adopt the T-60 reports for training and for the next refit of the live model if, in 2025-26, the upper 95% bound of the paired Brier difference is <= 0 for winner or for team_points, AND in neither test season does a team market (winner, team_points, game_total) have an upper bound above +0.0010. Otherwise v1.3 keeps its current reports. Player markets are reported, not decisive.
promotion: none; retrospective, seasons already inspected with v1.1-v1.4b, exploratory; the live module is not changed by this run
